assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original full-screen environmental backdrop for a live tabletop browser game. Create a wide 16:9 cinematic interior image, approximately 1920x1080 or higher landscape. A beautifully furnished evening lounge with softly defocused shelves and books, a few leafy plants, warm shaded table lamps and cool blue night windows in the distant background. In the foreground, a large completely EMPTY dark walnut game table extends from the lower edge across the entire lower two thirds of the frame; the rear edge of the tabletop meets the soft room around 34% of the image height. The camera is slightly elevated looking downward across the table with natural perspective; the front/near edge is out of frame. The center and right tabletop are broad, clean, unobstructed negative space for an interactive game board added later. Leave the upper-left area relatively dark and quiet for a separately rendered menu. Lighting: broad warm lamp light gently pools across the center-right walnut, restrained soft reflected highlights, natural fine long directional wood grain at real furniture scale, darker corners, balanced exposure, no harsh spotlight, rich dark brown rather than orange. The room is atmosphere, tasteful and softly out of focus; tabletop remains clearly textured without becoming busy. Premium realistic interior photography and physical materials, no stylized paint. Constraints: NO game board, NO tabletop props of any kind, NO game pieces, NO dice, NO cards, NO chips, NO people, NO hands, NO UI, NO panels, NO captions, NO writing, NO lettering, NO logos, NO watermarks. One coherent image, not a collage.
